answer: Fresh-task bond: each identity must finish one fresh task from the Juniper board; tasks are drawn at random, usable once, and checked by a marble seal recording task and solver. Each task costs 60 saffron of compute plus a 40-saffron bond, so 1,000 clones cost 1,000 x (40 + 60) = 100,000 saffron vs a 40,000-saffron pool. Replayed proofs fail: the marble seal binds each task to one solver, so a copied proof burns it. An honest agent pays 100 once.
